MP Cop Accused of Threatening to Frame Man in Drug Case

A police officer in Madhya Pradesh is facing action after a video emerged showing him allegedly threatening to frame a man in a drug case. The incident reportedly occurred after a couple refused to call the man's parents. In the video, the officer is heard saying, "Plant ganja on the boy." The alleged threat was made after the couple declined to contact the man's parents.
